configuration.modifier_interpretation: One catchall annual probability max(base tenure/nationality/category rate, conditional age-retention hazard); no independent mortality draw or legacy age floor. EB-4/5 retain the base rate.
configuration.sample_size_rule: Fixed counts declared before execution. Report attained MCSE; do not stop early or extend opportunistically to meet it.
configuration.sensitivity_budget_rationale: Fifty paired replications support the primary means and subgroup summaries. Ten paired replications per alternative age schedule characterize structural sensitivity. Historical replay retains the two previously completed pairs and adds eight pairs, with the expanded total fixed at ten before the additional runs. Its attained Monte Carlo precision is reported for matched changes. The two long-follow-up pairs remain a separate diagnostic.
configuration.uncertainty_scope: Student-t intervals describe numerical uncertainty in fixed-input simulation means. Age schedules and historical replay are separate sensitivity experiments, not probability bounds.

interpretation: Fixed sample sizes; sensitivities and long follow-up are distinct experiments.
